question: no prediction (batch 53: the rule fixed in Dan's text, 29 Oct 11:25, before any run)
rule_verbatim: Stretch, 53.8, a binding-ID test for the lookup's identity code (9B, then Muse): at L, take the state at item X's mention in its locker sentence minus X's token embedding (mean over scenes, X fixed by slot), add it at the bridge word at 1x / 2x the size of a real identity change, against a random vector of the same norm and against the same with another item Y's mention. Read: lookups sent to X's locker. Rule: "a shared identity code" if X's share minus random >= 0.25 at 2x and minus Y's version >= 0.15; "no" if <= 0.05; else in between.
rule: at 2x, point estimates (EPS 1e-09): "a shared identity code" if X - random >= 0.25 and X - Y >= 0.15; "no" if X - random <= 0.05 (Dan's "<= 0.05" read as X's share minus random's at 2x); else "in between"; a failed gate: "not tested (gate x < 0.80)"

design.scenes: x6_routes.scenes (seed 2510, 1000 per condition, prefix-stable), the C0 scenes in generator order; test pool = C0 scenes 1-700 (the routes runs'), X0's competence, gate and eligibility there, the first 300 eligible; mean pool = C0 scenes 701-1000 (held out: no test scene's own state enters a vector)
design.x_vector: per locker slot k: mean over the mean-pool scenes of (the block output at L at the k-th locker sentence's item word in O's chat lookup prompt) - (that token's input-embedding row, raw); X = the item at slot k (X fixed by slot); the item word is one token (the generator's rule, asserted)
design.x_and_y: per test scene the two items other than the bridge item A take turns as X and Y (X = slot k, Y = the remaining slot k'); both assignments pooled
design.dose: the size of a real identity change = ||Δ||, Δ = h_{S_B} - h_O at the bridge word at L (C0: Iris's pick A -> B, nothing else), per scene: x52_answer_map's ans1 / ans2 (s = ||Δ||); 1x and 2x
design.controls: a random Gaussian direction per scene (seed 5308) at the same norm; Y's version = slot k''s vector at the same norm
design.centered: Dan 12:10 (decisions_1210b item 1, before any run): a second arm with c~_k = c_k - (c_0 + c_1 + c_2) / 3 (the slot-specific part) in place of c_k, the same doses (d ||Δ||), the same random arm (same norm) and Y's centered version as controls, its own label by the same thresholds, beside; the headline is the uncentered arm's
design.read: X0's chat read, both readers; the lookup's top token classed by locker slot (the slot's digit token) or other; X's share = the lookup's top token is X's locker digit
design.collateral: the clean answers kept: the lookup's (A's locker) and the recall's (A's legs) top token unchanged
design.ci: cluster bootstrap over the bridge item A (10,000 draws, seed 0), arms paired
